adaptation.importance: first-order Taylor abs(weight * mean training-loss gradient), using Torch-Pruning GroupTaylorImportance for generic DepGraph groups
adaptation.isomorphic_scope: official Torch-Pruning isomorphic topology signature for generic groups; validated custom-rule signature for C3k2/C2PSA units
adaptation.one_shot_masks: channel/unit masks are frozen from the baseline scoring pass; raw replay never uses validation/test data or re-ranks
adaptation.shared_queue: equal-weight mean of domain-specific isomorphic round-robin queue indices; required only to keep the BDD 56% structural protocol common across GEN2 and NGN2

GEN2.gradient_accumulation: mean loss gradient per Conv2d weight over deterministic training batches

NGN2.gradient_accumulation: mean loss gradient per Conv2d weight over deterministic training batches

calibration_batches_policy: Exactly 50 training batches, matching the official Isomorphic-Pruning implementation default.
